policy: A frozen version is never edited and never re-issued: its file stays byte-identical and its blake3 digest is pinned here and in the crate's tests. A change is a new version with a new file, listed alongside the frozen ones, so a consumer at a pin can read the version it needs and verify it holds the bytes pons was tested against.
